name: OpenDesign Codespaces
postCreateCommand: corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.2 --activate && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if [ -n "$CODESPACE_NAME" ]; then export OD_ALLOWED_DEV_ORIGINS="${CODESPACE_NAME}-5173.${GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN:-app.github.dev}"; fi; pnpm tools-dev start web --daemon-port 7456 --web-port 5173'
